title: Large Language Models Predict Human Well-being—But Not Equally Everywhere
findings: LLMs generally captured the modest association between religiosity (frequency of religious service attendance) and life satisfaction. Unlike other predictors like education or perceived freedom where LLMs showed significant misestimation, their weighting of religiosity more closely mirrored the trend observed in the actual survey data.
